variants.headline: Still in view: assembly votes the government out
variants.sub: The government has been voted out by the Colonial Assembly.
variants.body:
The Colonial Assembly has voted the government out in {colony}. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

A lost confidence vote is a political fact with administrative significance. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.

variants.headline: Still in view: confidence withdrawn
variants.sub: An Assembly vote has removed the government in {colony}.
variants.body:
The government has been voted out by the Colonial Assembly. This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event.

A lost confidence vote is a political fact with administrative significance. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.

variants.body:
